legacy_all.label: Legacy All
legacy_all.note: Fallback for older split files with no phase markers.

any_act1.label: NG Story Act 1
any_act1.note: Mission-only first playthrough. Use this pass to clear the Act 1 story spine and take the story trophy pops, not the platinum board.

any_act2.label: NG Story Act 2
any_act2.note: Keep New Game on the main tale path. Cleanup remains intentionally deferred until the NG+ platinum pass.

any_act3.label: NG Story Act 3
any_act3.note: Finish the story shell and hand off into the real platinum route on New Game+.

ngp_act1.label: NG+ Platinum Act 1
ngp_act1.note: Second playthrough starts the real plat board. Izuhara is where the route cashes in the early collectible, duel, and liberation density.

ngp_act2.label: NG+ Platinum Act 2
ngp_act2.note: Toyotama carries the heaviest mid-route load: side tales, duels, lighthouses, camps, and mythic spillover.

ngp_act3.label: NG+ Platinum Act 3
ngp_act3.note: Kamiagata closes the final lighthouse, camp, tale, vanity, and Cooper work before the last mop-up.
